w: In the evening assembly, the Kishores presented a program, Leicester Satsang - Past, Present and Future. The special program was interwoven with dialogues, skits, a slide show and speeches that traced the establishment of the mandir in 1977 to the fostering of Satsang activities by Swamishri. The program was crowned with Swamishri's blessings.

Swamishri celebrated Rath Yatra festival by guiding a chariot of Thakorji through a remote control contraption. In the evening session of the shibir, Viveksagar Swami explained the history and significance of Rath Yatra festival and Swamishri blessed the assembly.

Children's Day This morning, 2,000 local children from twelve regions of Valsad district had assembled for the special Children's Day assembly. The program featured an impressive march-dance, a speech and a local welcome dance by children. In conclusion, Swamishri addressed the assembly.

ph: Swamishri prays prior to blessing the assembly

w: While Swamishri was taking his medicine he asked someone, “Would you like to have this?” The person replied, “Give me medicine that will cure me from the disease of the cycles of birth and death. And bless me that I am able to drink it no matter how bitter it is.” Swamishri instantly replied, “You have been given the medicine of listening to spiritual discourses ( katha ) and engaging in bhajan and kirtan. These are the medicines you have to take because they will help you to remain stable amid praise and insult, and joy and misery.”

A student expressed, “I love reading the Vachanamrut, but don’t feel like reading my school textbooks at all.” Swamishri encouraged him, “You must read both the Vachanamrut and your textbooks. By studying at school you’ll be able to make a career in life and by reading the Vachanamrut you will get spiritual knowledge. This will enable you to tide over joy and misery in life. You must learn to balance your life.”

ds.t: Give a medicine that cures the disease of rebirth
w: After his morning puja, as was his daily routine, Swamishri was taking his medicine, and Dharmapurush Swami was standing in front. Seeing his particular way of laughing, Swamishri noticed him and said, "Do you want some medicine?"
"If there is a medicine that cures the disease of birth and death, please give it, and bless us so that however bitter it tastes, we can drink it."

Swamishri said at once, "The medicine has already been given: discourses, bhajan and kirtan, these are all medicines to be taken, so that in honour and insult, happiness and sorrow, everything goes on and nothing goes wrong."
A student living at the Surat hostel came for Swamishri's darshan today. He complained, "I feel like reading the Vachanamrut, but I just do not feel like reading my study books."

Swamishri said at once, "Read the Vachanamrut, and read your study books too. If we study, our life is built, and if we read the Vachanamrut, we gain knowledge. Then happiness and sorrow will not trouble us. Learn to keep a balance between the two."

ds.t: Hold Maharaj in your heart and do bhajan
w: After lunch, in a conversation about an event, Swamishri spoke of Shastriji Maharaj's principle: "Shastriji Maharaj had one principle, that there is nothing to gain by fighting with anyone. If we fight, the other side will bring up everything under the sun. If not one thing, then another, and if not that, then a third; they will keep bringing it up. Rather than that, if we are in the right, hold Maharaj in your heart and do bhajan. Go for darshan everywhere. Do not criticise anyone. Even when people wrote against him, he did not reply. The foundation is to stay firm in what is true and to do only what is right. Even if we fail while doing what is right, it does not matter."
